name: cache-timer
description: A countdown in the prompt footer: under the hint line on the terminal, left of the model picker on the desktop: time left on the prompt cache and how much of the last request it served. Olive while there is plenty, warmer at 10, 5 and 2 minutes left (scaled down for a 5-minute cache). The lifetime follows Claude Code's own rules: 1 hour on a subscription, 5 minutes on an API key or usage credits.

lang.title: Language
lang.description: Band language: auto follows LANG (ru_* gives Russian), or pin ru / en

ttl.title: Cache lifetime
ttl.description: auto follows Claude Code's rules and corrects itself from request timing; 5m or 1h pins it

toast.title: One toast before expiry
toast.description: A single toast when the cache enters its last stage (2 minutes left on a 1-hour cache), only for prompts of 20k tokens or more
